caption: The drawing depicts a single, short-sleeved dress set against a plain, light beige background. The dress has a fitted bodice, a round neckline adorned with small lace trim, a cinched waist with a narrow waistband, and a full, knee-length skirt. The sleeves are short, slightly puffed, and also have lace trim at the edges. The entire dress is a light cream color with a repeating pattern of small pink and red floral motifs, each accompanied by green leaves. The floral pattern is uniformly distributed across the bodice, sleeves, waistband, and skirt.
title: Boy's Dress
